artifact: T0 (UNTRAINED-T) FUSION ARM -- FROZEN ELICITATION TEMPLATES
design_source: notes/2026-07-27__vat-run-registry.md, entry '2026-08-08 -- FROZEN DESIGN (before any scoring): UNTRAINED-T FUSION ARM'
rule: ONE fixed template per cell, written for ALL cells BEFORE any score exists. NO iteration of any template after seeing any score (that would make T0 trained-by-selection). NO bank-criterion text in any prompt. If a cell's score distribution collapses to one answer, that is RECORDED, not fixed.

model.why: the exact base checkpoint the program's LoRA dense T trains from (methods/dense/train_reward_model.py --base_model default, line 84)
model.mode: ZERO-SHOT, no LoRA, no chat template (base checkpoint has chat_template=false), offline batch vLLM
model.sampling: temperature=0.0, max_tokens=1, allowed_token_ids = the Yes/No variant set below, logprobs over that masked set

prompt_format.order: question sentence, then the document, then the fixed instruction

document_truncation.why: the SAME max length the trained dense T used (train_reward_model.py --max_length default 1024; score_eval_dense_v4.py DENSE_SCORE_MAXLEN=1024). The 1024 budget applies to the DOCUMENT; the question and the instruction are added on top so that every cell's document budget is identical to T's.

prompt_format.document_definition: the document string the trained dense T read for that row, byte-identical where the dense chain's own split file carries it (see t0_rows/<cell>.meta.json text_source). Cells whose dense text is pre-formatted (e.g. 'CONTEST HASHTAG: ...\n\nTWEET: "..."') keep that formatting -- T saw it too.

score.definition: P(Yes) = sum(exp(logprob) over POS variants) / (sum over POS + sum over NEG), computed from the FIRST generated token with the logits masked to the variant set

yes_no_variants.note: candidate surface forms; only those that encode to a SINGLE token under the Llama-3.1-8B tokenizer are used, and the realised id set is recorded in the score file

peer_verdict.question: Will the machine learning paper with the following abstract be accepted at the conference it was submitted to?
peer_verdict.preference_variable: ICLR venue decision: accepted vs rejected

peer_curation.question: Will the following accepted machine learning conference paper be selected for an oral or spotlight presentation rather than a poster?
peer_curation.preference_variable: presentation tier among ACCEPTED papers: oral/spotlight vs poster

peer_revealed.question: Will the following machine learning conference paper go on to be cited more often than most other papers published at the same venue in the same year?
peer_revealed.preference_variable: OpenAlex citation count in the top quartile within venue x year (bottom quartile = 0; middle 50% dropped)

nc_responded.question: Will the following public comment on a United States federal agency rulemaking receive a response from the agency in the final rule?
nc_responded.preference_variable: comment matched to a response-to-comments passage in the agency's final rule

nc_outcome.question: Will the agency change the rule in response to the following public comment on a United States federal agency rulemaking?
nc_outcome.preference_variable: majority of the comment's matched response labels are MADE (rule changed) rather than NONE; ties dropped

nc_agree.question: Will the agency agree with the following public comment on a United States federal agency rulemaking?
nc_agree.preference_variable: majority of the comment's matched response types are accepted/agree rather than disagree; ties dropped

cw_community.question: Will the following story written in response to a writing prompt be upvoted by readers on the online writing forum where it was posted?

hashtagwars_verdict.question: Will the following tweet be selected by the show's staff as one of the top entries in this hashtag contest?
hashtagwars_verdict.preference_variable: editorial selection into the episode's top-10 or as the winner

cap_finalist.question: Will the following reader-submitted caption be chosen by the editors as a finalist in the cartoon caption contest?
cap_finalist.preference_variable: editor-picked finalist; negatives are hard (crowd top-20 captions that were NOT picked)

cap_crowd.question: Will the following reader-submitted caption be rated more highly by readers than the typical caption entered in the same cartoon caption contest?
cap_crowd.preference_variable: crowd_mean strictly above the median crowd_mean of its own contest (>=100 votes; ties dropped)

jokes_community.question: Will the following joke posted to an online joke forum be upvoted more than most other jokes posted there?
jokes_community.preference_variable: Reddit score in the top quartile of its (length x format x topic) stratum; bottom quartile = 0
jokes_community.document: post title followed by the joke body

mathse_accepted_verdict.question: Will the following answer be marked as the accepted answer by the person who asked the mathematics question?

mathse_vote_score.question: Will the following answer receive a higher vote score than the typical answer to the same mathematics question?
mathse_vote_score.preference_variable: vote score strictly above the median answer score on its own question; ties dropped

aops_curation.question: Does the following forum solution take substantially the same approach as the official editorial solution to the same competition problem?
aops_curation.preference_variable: LLM-judge match label: the forum solution takes substantially the same approach as the editorial/wiki solution. NOT a preference or popularity signal -- the only cell in the grid whose y is a match label, so its question names the match, not a preference.

code_v3.question: Will the following GitHub pull request be merged into the repository?
code_v3.preference_variable: pull request merged vs closed without merge
code_v3.document: v3 enriched card: Title / Description / Review comments / Diff (pre-formatted, may carry a truncation marker)

press_verdict.question: Will the following press release be written up by multiple news outlets?
press_verdict.preference_variable: picked up by >=3 distinct tracked news outlets; negatives are topic-matched releases with zero pickups

homepage_curation_storygrouped.question: Will the following news headline be placed in the upper half of the most prominent zone of the news organisation's home page?
homepage_curation_storygrouped.preference_variable: homepage spatial placement: 1 = the link is rendered in the TOP half of the capture's top-30% zone, 0 = the bottom half (datasets/news-homepages/va/dense_standard_storygrouped/manifest.json y_definition)
homepage_curation_storygrouped.document: the dense arm's own row text, verbatim: 'HEADLINE: <focal headline>\n\nCONTEXT: <the other headlines on the same capture>' -- byte-identical to what the trained dense T read
homepage_curation_storygrouped.weak_instrument_flag: y is spatial placement, jointly determined with layout/ad/image constraints; carried on every number from this cell

label_definition_provenance: each cell's preference_variable was read off the cell's own builder/manifest before this file was written; the evidence trail (file:line per cell) is summarised in notes/2026-08-08__t0_untrained_arm.md
no_labels_seen: no y value and no T0 score existed at the time this file was written; the questions were derived from label DEFINITIONS (builder code and manifests) only

post_hoc_cell_additions.why: the T0 arm is a STANDING COLUMN of the battery (registry SCOPE AMENDMENT, user: 'for all cells' -- every future cell gets T0 + VAT0 at build time, homepage named explicitly in that amendment). The homepage cell's corrected story-grouped dense arm did not exist when the 16-cell file was frozen on 2026-08-08.
post_hoc_cell_additions.freeze_discipline: This template was written and committed to this file BEFORE any T0 score existed for this cell, and is not iterated afterwards -- the same rule the original 16 cells followed. The pre-existing 16 templates and every frozen field above are byte-unchanged; only this list and one new cells{} entry were added.
